entries.name: Polite past verbs
entries.description: Report a completed action or the absence of an action.
usageRules: End the main clause in polite past. Use the negative form where the meaning requires it.
examples: 何も買いませんでした。

entries.name: Everyday predicates
entries.pattern: 〜ます・〜ません・〜ています・〜たい・〜つもり
entries.description: Describe present or future events, ask questions and express desires or intentions.
usageRules: Choose a natural form for the situation and selected difficulty.

entries.name: Core particles
entries.pattern: は・が・を・に・で・へ・と・の・も
entries.description: Mark the topic, subject, object, location, direction, companion or noun relationship.
usageRules: Match the particle to the verb and the intended relationship.
examples: 公園で友達と遊びました。

entries.name: Time and manner modifiers
entries.pattern: 時間表現・副詞・形容詞の連用形
entries.description: Specify when, how or how much an action happened.
usageRules: Use only modifiers compatible with the event and time reference.
examples: 昨日、早く家を出ました。

entries.name: Polite request
usageRules: Use the appropriate te form followed by ください.
examples: ドアを開けてください。

entries.name: Past progressive
entries.description: Describe an ongoing action in the past.
usageRules: Use with an action underway at the stated time.
examples: 昨日、公園で遊んでいました。

entries.name: Sequence with after
usageRules: Mark the earlier action with てから.
examples: 家に帰ってから、ゆっくり休みました。

entries.name: Past existence
entries.pattern: 〜に〜がいました / ありました
entries.description: Describe who or what was present in the past.
usageRules: Use いる for animate entities and ある for inanimate entities in ordinary contexts.
examples: 昨日、会社には人がたくさんいました。

entries.name: Reported instruction
entries.pattern: 〜ように言いました / 言われました
entries.description: Report what someone was told to do.
usageRules: Make the speaker, recipient and requested action clear.
examples: 母に、公園では気をつけるように言われました。

entries.name: Contrast between clauses
entries.description: Link two events or statements in contrast.
usageRules: Each clause must contribute to the contrast.
examples: 店で服を見ましたが、何も買いませんでした。

entries.name: Interrupting an ongoing event
entries.description: Locate a second event partway through the first event.
usageRules: Name the ongoing event clearly and keep the sequence coherent.
examples: 昨夜、友達と映画を見ましたが、途中で帰りました。
